title: The Rain in Jack's Little Tube
synopsis: After the first rainy night since the gauge was installed, Jack, Rex and Gus discover that the empty rain gauge at Pine Park now holds a measurable amount of water.
continuity_state: Before: Dan has completed his delivery route. The rain gauge at Pine Park has been empty since Aunt Jo mounted it in open grass by the gate. The park, bridge, farm, and garage are operating normally. After: A steady overnight rainfall has passed. The park rain gauge contains water to its third marked line; Jack records the level in his blue notebook without emptying it yet. A shallow puddle remains at the paved roadside near Pine Park. Both the park and the pedestrian Little Bridge remain open.
